Name: Damp
Effect: While this Pokémon is an Active Combatant; No Active Combatants are able to use Explosive Moves or the Move Burn Up, The Ability Aftermath does not activate, and Equipment Modules with the Explosive Trait will not explode.
Description: The Pokémon gathers the humidity in the air around itself. Lighting a spark or keeping a fire on, will be almost impossible close to it.
